title: CAD/case-report crosscheck against 10 ALPR search IDs, 3 incidents
summary: For each of three CAD/incident numbers (202504040004 on 4/4/2025; 202512050234 on 12/5/2025; 202503280193 on 3/28/2025), asks for (1) the CAD event chronology/unit history/dispatch log and (2) the incident/case report including any assigned RMS case number and disposition. Separately, Item 3 asks for any record or log entry maintained through the Department's Flock ALPR system corresponding to ten named search IDs, invoking the Department's own case-number-entry requirement for ALPR searches as context.

policy_promises.quote: records of investigations conducted by ... any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Whether a blanket exemption claim survives where Items 1 and 2 (CAD chronology, case report) would themselves establish that a given incident did not result in an investigation.

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection ... after deletion of the portions that are exempt by law
policy_promises.tests: Whether the CAD chronology (an operational dispatch record) is segregable from any narrative report content withheld under § 7923.600 for the same call.

filed_because: Cross-checks whether ALPR searches tied to specific CAD/incident numbers correspond to real, documented calls and case dispositions, testing the Department's case-number-entry requirement against the underlying CAD/RMS record for each cited incident.
notes: Filed 2026-09-14. Statutory 10-day initial determination due 2026-09-24 (Gov. Code § 7922.535(a)).
